description: Get overview statistics for a time period, including reply count and reply rate. Counts form a funnel over the sends made inside the period: opened and clicked are unique per email send (not total open events) and include engagement that arrives after the period ends, so they never exceed sent. Rates divide by rateDenominator (delivered, falling back to sent), reported alongside rateDenominatorBasis. Set emailType to transactional for Send API and transactional SMTP open/click rates, including both direct and saved-template sends. Also returns top-level subscriberCount (every stored contact) and activeSubscriberCount (status=active) as a live audience snapshot, independent of period; use these for 'how many subscribers do I have' instead of search_subscribers pagination.total. When no emailType filter is used and a background-computed snapshot is available, the response also includes a top-level commerceForecast with predicted AOV, 12-month customer value, 90-day revenue, confidence, and data-eligibility reasons.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

emailType.description: Optional structural email type filter: campaign, transactional, or sequence. Use transactional for Send API and transactional SMTP traffic.

includeMachineEngagement.description: If true, include machine-classified bot/scanner opens and clicks. Defaults to false, so metrics and activity are human-only.

mailboxProvider.description: Mailbox provider filter, e.g. gmail or microsoft.

outcome.description: Only sends that bounced this way or drew a spam complaint. With get_stats_breakdown by=email it shows which emails the bounces or complaints came from. Filtered stats report replies as 0.

source.description: Source filter <type>:<id> with type campaign, sequence, sequence_step or transactional.

start.description: ISO 8601 range start; needs end. Max 90 days.

name: get_stats

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `get_stats` MCP tool.

activeSubscriberCount.description: Live count of contacts with status=active. Independent of period. May include phone-only contacts without an email address.

commerceForecast.description: The Optional background-computed commerce AOV, 12-month customer value, and 90-day revenue forecast. Omitted when no snapshot is available; insufficient_data is returned only after eligibility was evaluated successfully. record returned by Sequenzy.

emailType.description: Applied structural email type filter when one was requested.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

mailboxProvider.description: Applied recipient mailbox provider filter when one was requested.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

outcome.description: Applied send outcome filter (permanent_bounce, temporary_bounce, blocked or complaint) when one was requested. Filtered responses report replies as 0.

recipientDomain.description: Applied recipient domain filter when one was requested.

source.description: Applied email source filter (<type>:<id>) when one was requested. Filtered responses report replies as 0.

stats.description: Account-wide delivery funnel for the requested window. `opened` and `clicked` are unique counts deduplicated by email send (one recipient opening five times counts once), not total open events. Every count is attributed to the sends made inside the requested window, including engagement that arrives after the window ends, so `opened <= delivered <= sent` always holds. Rates use `rateDenominator` (`delivered`, or `sent` when no delivery events were recorded, reported as `rateDenominatorBasis`); `deliveryRate` and `bounceRate` divide by `sent`.

subscriberCount.description: Live count of every stored contact in the company. Independent of period. Use this for 'how many subscribers do I have'.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
